title: Accumulator Orbs
text: Accumulator Orbs mount in any direction and distribute power without storing it. Base throughput is 8192 MPU. The single upgrade slot accepts Stacking or Infused Stacking.

The base only accepts pulses, stress or FE. Other faces accept only pulses and output all three. FE converts at its actual rate per second. Shaft inputs require at least 16 rpm; outputs are fixed at 16 rpm. Shafts must be perpendicular; unloaded spinning costs nothing. All outputs share one MPU budget, shown in gold. Spacetime Ports extend these faces. Orbs do not charge nearby players.

Set a Resonant Accumulator Orb's frequency with two item markers. Same-frequency orbs in one dimension are one node, sharing potential and one upgrade slot accessible from any orb. Merging retains the strongest capacity upgrade and returns extras. Stabilization shares the group across dimensions without adding or reducing throughput capacity.

Cyan shows available capacity, gold shows power in use, and the full bar marks the throughput limit. Idle branches split the available capacity evenly. Active branches can borrow unused capacity. The same flow passes through each node in series, so adding their gold readings counts it more than once.
